Function: Final particle; assertion or soft emphasis ('indeed', 'is', '=')
Structural Role: Marks closure or resolution; recursion flattening

Function: Genitive or associative marker ('of', sometimes object marker)
Structural Role: Marks relational structure; connector of recursion layers

Function: Nominalizer; turns phrases into nouns ('the one who...')
Structural Role: Encodes recursion identity; turns process into subject
Structural referent or pointer; recursive aliasing

Function: Means or method marker ('by means of', 'using')
Structural Role: Means of transformation; method of recursion

Function: Question particle; marks rhetorical or real questions ('how?', 'what about?')
Structural Role: Opens a paradox or invites recursive questioning

Function: Final particle indicating change, completed action, or emphasis
Structural Role: Closure of phase/state; marks recursive update

Function: Locative or abstract final particle ('therein', 'at it', 'in that')
Structural Role: Binds location or abstract context to recursion
Indicates structural implication or conditional unfolding
Analogy or mapping across recursive levels
